name: Long March 2C
location_str: LC-9 @ Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation's 41st launch of the year, 611th all time. 2nd from LC-9 this year, 144 days since the last one. The 195th orbital launch attempt worldwide this year. Long March 2C is on a 43 flight success streak.
slot_b_text: Most rockets use a 'Gravity Turn', tilting slightly after liftoff to let gravity do the work of turning the rocket horizontal.
rocket_fact: Most rockets use a 'Gravity Turn', tilting slightly after liftoff to let gravity do the work of turning the rocket horizontal.
